rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Code Sentinel is a code quality analysis server that detects issues commonly introduced by AI coding assistants. It analyzes code for 93 distinct patterns across 5 categories including security vulnerabilities (hardcoded secrets, SQL injection, XSS), deceptive patterns (empty catch blocks, silent failures), placeholders (TODO comments, incomplete code), and code smells (type coercion, async anti-patterns). Provides structured JSON analysis and visual HTML reports with quality scores.
